plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Radware Alteon load balancer. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for Alteon ADC (enterprise PEN 1872).
name: Loadbalance

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Management-processor CPU utilization of the Radware Alteon (ALTEON-CHEETAH-SWITCH-MIB mpCpuStatsUtil64Seconds), reported directly as a percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total main memory of the Radware Alteon in bytes (mpMemStatsTotal).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used main memory of the Radware Alteon in bytes (mpMemStatsUsed).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free main memory of the Radware Alteon in bytes (mpMemStatsFree).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Main memory utilization of the Radware Alteon, derived as used/total.
